items.en_title: Barra do Corda (MA) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 20 #03
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Barra do Corda (MA) is procuring professional or outsourced services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 592,878; proposals close Nov 20, 23:59 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
